blurb: Guests board the Showboat Branson Belle for a cruise on Table Rock Lake featuring a 3-course meal served at their table and a live musical show by the Rivertown Ramblers. The vessel has three interior decks with large windows and an exterior deck for scenic views. The experience includes family-style seating and opportunities to stroll the decks before docking.
extraNote: No alcoholic beverages available on the Showboat · Reservations must be cancelled at least 24 hours prior to cruise time for refund · No video cameras allowed inside vessel; allowed on outer decks only · Smoking allowed only outdoors on second deck · All guests must wear appropriate attire · White River Landing, Table Rock Lake, Branson, MO
